meta.name: add-rtk
meta.description: Install rtk token-compression proxy into agent containers. Routes Bash tool calls through rtk for 60–90% token savings on dev commands (git, cargo, pytest, docker, kubectl, etc.).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在容器中安装 rtk 代理以压缩令牌，节省开发命令的令牌消耗
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 AI 辅助开发且想减少令牌消耗
copy.tagline_en: Install rtk proxy in containers to compress tokens and save on dev commands
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI-assisted development and want to reduce token usage

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 执行终端命令(如 git status、pytest)时,输出会先经过 rtk 代理压缩,从而节省 token 消耗。该技能还会把 rtk 挂载进容器,并配置自动钩子,无需额外说明。
howto.when: 当 Claude 准备运行 Bash 工具命令(如 git、pytest、docker 等)时,会自动被 rtk 拦截并压缩输出。每次执行前都会触发。

say.text: 运行 git status 看当前仓库状态
say.note: 命令正常执行,输出被压缩以省 token。

say.text: 帮我跑一下 pytest 测试
say.note: 测试会照常运行,输出被压缩。

say.text: 执行 docker ps 列出容器
say.note: 容器列表正常显示,输出更精简。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude's Bash tool calls (e.g. git status, pytest) are routed through the rtk proxy, which compresses output to save tokens. The skill also mounts rtk into containers and configures a hook, so no extra instructions are needed.
howto.when_en: Triggered whenever Claude runs a Bash command (such as git, pytest, docker, etc.); rtk intercepts and compresses the output before execution.

say_en.text: Run git status to see the repo state
say_en.note: Command runs normally, output compressed to save tokens.
Output compressed; container list shows as usual.
